label: Knowledge (RAG)
title: Knowledge Settings
subtitle: Configure the embedding model, how documents are split, how many passages a search returns, and the databases available across projects.
description: The RAG tab controls how InnoviumAI indexes documents and retrieves relevant passages. Settings here apply platform-wide; project-specific databases are added from within each project.

settings.name: Embedding Model
settings.description: The model used to convert text into vectors. Both indexing and retrieval must use the same model.

settings.name: Top-K Results
settings.description: How many passages a search returns when the caller asks for no particular number.

settings.name: Max Chunk Size
settings.description: Largest number of characters in a piece when a long document is split for indexing.

settings.name: Local Databases
settings.description: Named vector databases stored on your machine. Create databases and upload documents from this panel.

settings.name: External Databases
settings.description: Connect to remote vector databases with an endpoint URL and optional API credentials.

mediaCaption: The RAG settings tab showing the embedding model selector, the Top-K and Max Chunk Size fields, and the local database list with upload controls
tips: Changing the embedding model after indexing documents leaves the existing ones behind: at best they score poorly against a query the new model produced, and where the two models size their vectors differently, searching the database and adding to it both fail until you re-index. Open a knowledge base and choose Reindex to re-embed its documents with the new model; nothing needs uploading again.
Top-K of 5 is a good starting point; increase to 8–10 if agents frequently miss relevant context, decrease if responses contain too much irrelevant detail.
